DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'Supplier'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);
targets:
LINEAGEKEY := (SELECT
   TOP 1
      "Lineage Key"
                                 FROM
      Integration.Lineage
                                 WHERE
      "Table Name" = 'Supplier'
                                 AND "Data Load Completed" IS NULL
                                 ORDER BY "Lineage Key" DESC);

WITH RowsToCloseOff
    AS
    (
        SELECT s.[WWI Supplier ID], MIN(s.[Valid From]) AS [Valid From]
        FROM Integration.Supplier_Staging AS s
        GROUP BY s.[WWI Supplier ID]
    )
    UPDATE s
        SET s.[Valid To] = rtco.[Valid From]
    FROM Dimension.[Supplier] AS s
    INNER JOIN RowsToCloseOff AS rtco
    ON s.[WWI Supplier ID] = rtco.[WWI Supplier ID]
    WHERE s.[Valid To] = @EndOfTime;
targets:
UPDATE Dimension.Supplier s
   SET
      s."Valid To" = rtco."Valid From"
   FROM
      (
         WITH RowsToCloseOff
         AS
         (
             SELECT
                s."WWI Supplier ID",
                MIN(s."Valid From") AS "Valid From"
             FROM
                Integration.Supplier_Staging AS s
             GROUP BY
                s."WWI Supplier ID"
         )
         SELECT
             *
         FROM
             RowsToCloseOff
      ) AS rtco
   WHERE
      s."WWI Supplier ID" = rtco."WWI Supplier ID"
      AND (s."Valid To" = :ENDOFTIME);

            [Was Successful] = 1
